conditions: Navigate to a product detail page from the catalogue list
Check Add to cart button is present
items.expected: Product name, price, description and Add to cart button are all visible on the detail page

conditions: Clicking - when quantity is 1 does not go below 1
items.expected: Quantity increments and decrements correctly, never falling below 1

conditions: A related products section is visible on the detail page
Clicking a related product navigates to that product's detail page
items.expected: Related products section is present; clicking one opens its own detail page

conditions: Run axe-core on the product detail page form/content area
Pin WCAG 2.1 A and AA rule tags
items.expected: No axe-core violations on the product detail page

excluded.reason: Admin product search does not narrow the list — this is about the admin interface, not the shopper product detail page; it does not touch TOOL-11's behaviour
Billing address step not filled from customer profile — this is about checkout/billing flow, not the product detail page; it does not touch TOOL-11's behaviour
Both open bugs (TOOL-21, TOOL-20) are unrelated to this story's behaviour; no confirmation tests are applicable here
The product detail page is publicly accessible content with no authentication, session, or account-data protection concerns implied by this story
